statement: The read-availability invariant is stated once in the machine-readable contract registry and enforced by a verdict-matrix test: a failed or unavailable authoritative read never concludes the positive premise of a safety gate (admission gates fail closed into typed defer/deny); a hold may fail open on a read gap only where blocking on the gap would itself deadlock convergence, and each fail-open hold names its deadlock witness; advisory probes fail open only where a fail-closed enforcer remains downstream. Each fail-open verdict carries a red-on-revert witness.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
